items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Do you remember the thing he made with Freddie Slack?

ctx.x: special. Actually, T-Bone opened up the guitar players. All the guitar players out today playing guitar owe T-Bone a debt of gratitude, because he really helped them. Do you remember the thing he made with Freddie Slack? I can't remember the name of the song. Anyway, he played a classic solo, and every guitar player since then has played some parts of that solo.

But anyway, I had played...began to get known, and I first met Sonny Stitt when he came to Detroit with the Trenier twins. The Trenier twins had a big band. They were from Alabama State, and they were out on the road. That's where I first met them, was in Detroit. They also had in the band with them... They had Joe Morris, a trumpet player who had a band and some big records later, and a very fine tenor saxophone player, Don Hill...
